records.identity_caution: Do not absorb records explicitly labeled Tridens muticus var. elongatus or Tridentopsis mutica var. elongata; Kew treats those as a distinct accepted Tridentopsis elongata. Canonical T. mutica retained unchanged.
records.handoff: Review any legacy var. elongatus observations separately before assigning a species card.
